label: Divine justice: conformity of willed acts versus distributive completeness
resolution: JUSTICE_1 (GodActsJustly) says every act a GOD_4 with classical attributes wills is Fitting; JUSTICE_2 (GodRendersAllDue) says such a GOD_4 wills every act due to some being. The #1457 route to the veracity premise GodAssertionsPermitted uses JUSTICE_1 only. JUSTICE_1 does not entail JUSTICE_2: the structural control ConformityNotCompleteness keeps both premises of JUSTICE_1 and an unwilled due act. No argument passes from one sense to the other; JUSTICE_2 is used only in that control and in the joint sample. Objections from unrelieved suffering of the just bear on JUSTICE_2 directly and on JUSTICE_1 only through a further premise that withholding a due is an unfitting willed act, which is not encoded.
